name: Under Eye Patches Gift Set (12 Pairs)
editorialDescription: Single-use hydrogel under-eye patches in three colour-coded formulas (gold, blue and pink), sold as a 12-pair gift pack. You wear them for about 20 minutes. They mainly hydrate and cool the skin under the eyes, which can make puffiness and dryness less noticeable for a while. The listing names glycerin, sodium hyaluronate, trehalose and chondrus crispus among the ingredients, with niacinamide in the blue patches.
keyFeatures: 12 pairs across three formulas: gold, blue and pink
Gold is aimed at tired, dehydrated eyes, blue contains niacinamide for a brighter look, and pink is a hyaluronic acid moisture formula (brand descriptions)
Wear for about 20 minutes; the brand suggests chilling them in the fridge for extra cooling
Brand states the patches are vegan and cruelty-free; the listing says paraben-, phthalate- and sulfate-free
advantages: Three formulas in one pack, so you can try them before buying a larger size
A quick, cooling step that fits before makeup
Established brand with its own shop and larger refill packs
disadvantages: Effects are temporary; patches don't change dark circles caused by pigmentation or facial structure
Single-use, so the cost per use adds up
Wrinkle-smoothing, 'instant results' and celebrity-use claims on the listing aren't independent evidence
Patches can slide if you move around while wearing them
suits: People who want a short hydrating step before makeup or an event
Anyone curious to compare several patch formulas
skipIf: You expect lasting changes to dark circles or under-eye bags
Your under-eye skin is very reactive; patch-test first
buyingConsiderations: grace & stella sells many variants, so confirm the pack count (12 pairs) and colour mix on the listing
Check that the seller is Grace & Stella Co.
Read the ingredient list if you're sensitive, and keep patches away from the lash line
